what: From integrate-docs-cargo (read from code): (1) crates/blaze-cargo/src/stub.rs is an orphan file (no mod stub) that runs rustc: delete (no-rustc). (2) manifest opt-outs unsandboxed-proc-macros, build-script-env, wasi-build-scripts are accepted and only checked to be lists, then ignored (blaze-units load/sandbox.rs): a silent no-op, make them errors or honour them (no-fallback; with usercode). (3) no doctests (blaze test --doc makes none), no daemon idle exit, no command reports the Rust version, no blaze cache list/clear (blaze_cache::store::clear_stale uncalled). docs/cargo.md and docs/usage.md now say these as v2 gaps.
